reviews.text: Thank you, Riccardo Paolucci, for your valuable time and for the wonderful review! Come visit us again soon at Arcaplanet stores!
A well-stocked pet supermarket! They have all the best brands of dry and wet food, and the staff is helpful.

I've been a customer at this store for over 10 years. It's a nice, well-stocked shop, but given the fine their security gave me for overstaying my order by a few minutes after purchasing from them, and the store next door with the same €40 parking fee, after one free hour, your only option is to pay €40, which even a private parking fee for a day doesn't charge that much.
Honestly, it seems unfair to me, but I'll definitely change stores, since there's no shortage of similar shops in the neighborhood.
When there are special offers it's really worth it

The store is well-stocked, but the real added value is the staff. Special thanks to Ugo, Giusy, and Alex at Arcaplanet on Lungotevere di Pietra Papa! Always available, extremely knowledgeable in guiding you through your purchases, and incredibly helpful and quick to resolve a complicated tax issue for me. When kindness meets unparalleled professionalism.
The offers in June, July, and August were also great, with a 20% discount on everything! They arrived by mail.
Highly recommended!

I'll never go there again. Nothing to complain about the staff, but being ripped off for paying €29, which is something you'll find almost everywhere else for between €20 and €24.
Do yourself a favor, either go online or use the internet. Instead of giving €9-5 to vile speculators, you can use them for your pet.
Thanks Barbara, we're happy to hear your positive feedback about Arcaplanet! Thank you so much for your trust.
Thank you, Andrea Della Felice. Your little stars made us shine! Come back and visit us.
Impeccable service. Thank you!
Optimal
Terrible service!
Very large, well-kept shop, with really friendly staff. A must-have for pet owners.

I can only confirm the many opinions expressed previously.

The South American guy must receive, with immediate effect, the medal for the most rude and impolite of all Arcaplanet employees!!!

I've been using many stores in various cities for years... but this guy wins everyone over with his arrogance and lack of respect!!
Learn how to treat the public!!!
Spacious, well-stocked premises, professional and friendly staff, excellent value for money.

Be careful with the parking lot: they take your picture at the entrance without issuing a timed ticket and charge you €40 with a fine sent home if you park for more than an hour. Considering there are other shops in that area, time can easily fly by.

The products and offers are standard. There are never any exceptional deals. I no longer trust the advice of the clerks, especially the gentleman I believe to be South American. It seems like the advice is only given to make you spend more. After several experiences, I've decided not to frequent this store anymore. There are many Arcaplanet stores with much more professional and kind staff.

Be careful!! Unfortunately, I hadn't noticed that parking for more than an hour costs 40 euros to do some shopping at Brikofer and Arcaplanet stores.
So it cost me an arm and a leg... my bad... but those 40 euros are a burden, and I won't go to those stores again... because an information cart in the stores wouldn't have gotten me a fine.
Beware of parking scams. A €40 fine, even for short stays. The parking lot is managed by a shadowy external company that automatically generates revenue from fines. Stay away. Avoid this shop.
Extremely well-stocked pet shop with friendly and helpful staff for advice
Well stocked, with friendly and knowledgeable staff. A bit pricey on some products.
A well-stocked pet shop. Quality and expertise.
Fantasticoottimo
Fantastic experience. The staff was extremely knowledgeable and I found them extremely kind and empathetic. Highly recommended!

I recently went to this shop to buy kibble for my dog. I was served by a very knowledgeable, helpful, and kind girl. I think her name was Ingrid. She gave me advice and helped me choose the right product. She also explained a possible insurance policy to me. We'll look into that, too. Thank you so much. I'll definitely be back.
Excellent service, trained and helpful staff.
Great shop for dog and cat owners
Friendly, knowledgeable staff, always available for any information

The store is large and well-stocked, and the prices are competitive. The clerks are all kind and helpful, except for the South American gentleman with glasses, who needs to calm down because, in addition to making unprofessional comments toward customers (I wanted to pay for four bags of cat food split between two bills, and he blurted out an annoying "Oh Jesus"), he also treats his colleagues rudely and harassingly. It's not the first time I've witnessed such an antics, but today one of the guys came back to the register with a pile of €2 change, probably changed at the store next door, and this South American "gentleman" started treating him like an idiot, even blurting out a truly obnoxious phrase: "Don't you understand Italian?"
I understand the stress and all, but you can't treat your colleagues like that.
By the way, I'm Mexican, so it has nothing to do with nationality or anything else, but only with respect for the human being who is next to you and who, like you, works and struggles to bring home a salary.
Friendly staff who look after you and advise you
A great experience. As always with Adcaplanet, the staff is always available, even if you arrive five minutes before closing (which isn't easy), and the store is always well-stocked.
Excellent prices and great courtesy
You can really find everything for our singing and four-legged friends.
Well-stocked shop for our pets.
